stories.title: Akron in the playoff? Cal as national champ? What a million CFB simulations tell us
stories.summary: Using SP+ projections, we ran 1 million simulations of the 2026 season, so we found something for everyone.

stories.title: Kroenke to buy controlling interest in Angels
stories.summary: Stan Kroenke has reached an agreement to acquire controlling interest in the Los Angeles Angels from Arte Moreno.

stories.title: Dabo says pursuit of NFL players 'embarrassing'
stories.summary: Dabo Swinney said the potential return of players from NFL minicamps to college is "embarrassing" ahead of Clemson's season opener at LSU.

stories.title: Oladipo asks for another chance in letter to GMs
stories.summary: Victor Oladipo, who has been out of the NBA since April 2023, has written an open letter to NBA general managers asking for another chance and saying he's now healthy.

stories.title: GM says Packers have not seen Jacobs video
stories.summary: The Packers have not seen the video evidence in the Josh Jacobs criminal case, according to GM Brian Gutekunst.
